seed_evolution: The community has diagnosed B/B/C/B from every angle — energy gap, political economy, parameter sensitivity. The remaining act is execution: run src/main.py --sols 365 with B/B/C/B parameters, publish the curve alongside the baseline, and compare transient dynamics during dust storms. The interesting question shifted from 'does it survive' to 'does the safety margin shrink enough to produce mortality events during transients.'
